title: Closed-fibre inverse system of proper finite-type integer models
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, and f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Put Y_0=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I) [def-pc-fibre-product]. There are a nonempty directed preordered set \Lambda, an inverse system D:\Lambda^{op}\to\mathrm{Sch}, and a limiting cone \pi:Y_0\to D [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with affine transitions [pqf-def-affine-morphism] and quasi-compact quasi-separated stages [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For each i there are a commutative finite-type integer algebra R_i, \alpha_i:R_i\to A, a proper h_i:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}R_i, p_i:Y\to X_i, and an isomorphism e_i:D_i\cong X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R_i}\operatorname{Spec}(R_i/\alpha_i^{-1}I). They satisfy p_i;h_i=f;\operatorname{Spec}\alpha_i, j_Y;p_i=(\pi_i;e_i);j_i, and (\pi_i;e_i);\operatorname{pr}_i=\operatorname{pr}_{A/I};\operatorname{Spec}\bar\alpha_i, where \bar\alpha_i is the induced quotient map and j_Y,j_i are the first pullback projections. No finite etale cover is an input or output.

proof.text: Noetherian approximation of $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A$. $\operatorname{Spec}A$ is affine, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and $f$ is proper. By [lem-weil-pbc-proper-limit-noetherian] (affine clause) there are a directed set $\Lambda$ and an inverse system $(f_\lambda:Y_\lambda\to S_\lambda)_{\lambda\in\Lambda}$ with affine transition morphisms, $f_\lambda$ proper, $S_\lambda=\operatorname{Spec}A_\lambda$ with $A_\lambda$ a finitely generated $\mathbf Z$-algebra, $Y=\varprojlim_\lambda Y_\lambda$ (projections $p_\lambda:Y\to Y_\lambda$), $\operatorname{Spec}A=\varprojlim_\lambda S_\lambda$ and $A=\varinjlim_\lambda A_\lambda$ with coprojections $\alpha_\lambda:A_\lambda\to A$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition], and $f_\lambda\circ p_\lambda=(\operatorname{Spec}\alpha_\lambda)\circ f$.

proof.text: The ideals. Put $I_\lambda=\alpha_\lambda^{-1}(I)\subseteq A_\lambda$. For $\mu\le\lambda$ the transition map $\varphi_{\mu\lambda}:A_\mu\to A_\lambda$ satisfies $\alpha_\lambda\varphi_{\mu\lambda}=\alpha_\mu$, so $\varphi_{\mu\lambda}(I_\mu)\subseteq I_\lambda$ and $(A_\lambda,I_\lambda)$ is a directed system of pairs. Every $x\in A$ is $\alpha_\lambda(a)$ for some $\lambda$ and $a\in A_\lambda$ [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-algebras-elementwise]; if $x\in I$ then $a\in I_\lambda$. Hence $I=\bigcup_\lambda\alpha_\lambda(I_\lambda)$, i.e. $(A,I)=\varinjlim_\lambda(A_\lambda,I_\lambda)$ as pairs, and the induced maps $A_\lambda/I_\lambda\to A/I$ are injective with union $A/I$, so $A/I=\varinjlim_\lambda A_\lambda/I_\lambda$. (Stacks: 'Thus we also have $I=\colim I_i$ and $A/I=\colim A_i/I_i$'.)

proof.text: The closed fibres form an inverse system with limit $Y_0$. Put $S_{\lambda,0}=\operatorname{Spec}(A_\lambda/I_\lambda)$, $Y_{\lambda,0}=Y_\lambda\times_{S_\lambda}S_{\lambda,0}$ and $S_0=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$. (a) By step 2 and [lem-weil-pbc-spec-colimit-limit], $S_0=\varprojlim_\lambda S_{\lambda,0}$. (b) For $\mu\le\lambda$ the morphism $Y_{\lambda,0}\to Y_{\mu,0}$ induced by $Y_\lambda\to Y_\mu$ and $S_{\lambda,0}\to S_{\mu,0}$ factors as $Y_{\lambda,0}=Y_\lambda\times_{S_\lambda}\operatorname{Spec}(A_\lambda/I_\lambda)\to Y_\lambda\times_{S_\lambda}\operatorname{Spec}(A_\lambda/I_\mu A_\lambda)=Y_\lambda\times_{Y_\mu}Y_{\mu,0}\to Y_{\mu,0}$: the first arrow is a base change of the closed immersion $\operatorname{Spec}(A_\lambda/I_\lambda)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A_\lambda/I_\mu A_\lambda)$ ($I_\mu A_\lambda\subseteq I_\lambda$ by step 2), hence a closed immersion [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change], hence affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]; the second is a base change of the affine $Y_\lambda\to Y_\mu$, hence affine [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence]; a composite of affine morphisms is affine (preimages of affine opens stay affine). So $(Y_{\lambda,0})$ is an inverse system with affine transition morphisms, and its limit exists [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. (c) Each $Y_{\lambda,0}\to S_{\lambda,0}$ is proper [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change], hence quasi-compact and separated [def-weil-proper-morphism]; as $S_{\lambda,0}$ is affine, $Y_{\lambda,0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence]. (d) $Y_0=\varprojlim_\lambda Y_{\lambda,0}$ with projections $q_\lambda=p_\lambda\times(S_0\to S_{\lambda,0}):Y_0\to Y_{\lambda,0}$: for every scheme $T$, $\operatorname{Mor}(T,\varprojlim Y_{\lambda,0})=\varprojlim_\lambda\big(\operatorname{Mor}(T,Y_\lambda)\times_{\operatorname{Mor}(T,S_\lambda)}\operatorname{Mor}(T,S_{\lambda,0})\big)$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and since limits commute with limits this is $\operatorname{Mor}(T,Y)\times_{\operatorname{Mor}(T,\operatorname{Spec}A)}\operatorname{Mor}(T,S_0)=\operatorname{Mor}(T,Y_0)$ by step 1 and (a), naturally in $T$; conclude by Yoneda. (Stacks: 'The same thing is true for schemes finite etale over $X_0=\lim(X_i\times_{S_i}S_{i,0})$'.) The cone projection composed with the chosen stage isomorphism gives the two displayed projection identities by the pullback lift equations. This proves only the approximation system, independently of any cover.

lean.statement: theorem exists_proper_closedFibre_approximation {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f] : ∃ (Λ : Type u) (_ : Preorder Λ) (_ : Nonempty Λ) (_ : IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)) (D : Λᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (π : (Functor.const Λᵒᵖ).obj (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) ⟶ D), Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk _ π)) ∧ (∀ {i j : Λᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)) ∧ (∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i)) ∧ (∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)) ∧ ∀ i : Λᵒᵖ, ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (_ : Algebra.FiniteType ℤ R) (α : R →+* A) (X : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (_ : IsProper h) (p : Y ⟶ X) (e : D.obj i ≅ pullback h (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.comap α))))), p ≫ h = f ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α) ∧ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ≫ p = (π.app i ≫ e.hom) ≫ pullback.fst h (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.comap α)))) ∧ (π.app i ≫ e.hom) ≫ pullback.snd h (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.comap α)))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.quotientMap I α le_rfl))
